authority_invariant: PentaContext preserves scoped, classified, provenance-bound operational memory. Context is evidence, never authority, and cannot manufacture credentials, permissions, provider-write authority, governance approval, rights, money movement or D3 effects.

systems.purpose: Ingest, redact, deduplicate, retain and retrieve scope-isolated context with source provenance, classification ceilings, bounded result budgets and append-only receipts.
systems.human_surface: Scoped operational-memory health, provenance, queue state and bounded context packs
systems.authority_boundary: Context is evidence, never authority. It may inform PentaBrain, PentaNerves, PentaBody, certification and recovery workflows, but every consequential downstream action still requires its own authority and current evidence.
systems.evidence_scope: PENTACONTEXT.md production canaries and exact scoped receipts; no authority is inferred from stored or retrieved context

five_stage.discover: Receive approved source material through a governed acquisition adapter with exact scope and provenance.
five_stage.govern: Apply classification ceilings, local and recursive secret redaction, source trust, retention and character budgets.
five_stage.execute: Synchronously ingest or durably enqueue a scope-isolated context record.
five_stage.verify: Return fingerprints, output hashes, queue state and append-only receipts without granting downstream authority.
five_stage.preserve: Retain bounded operational memory and tombstone expired records while preserving receipt lineage.
